document.about: Invented lines printed to PDF by headless Chrome on macOS (fixtures/word-symbol-fonts.html), setting characters in Symbol and Wingdings by their private-use codes, as a PDF made from Word does: Symbol and Wingdings-Regular as CID TrueType, whose text maps give U+F0xx. Operators, a Greek letter, an arrow, and three bullets: Symbol's, a Wingdings square and a Wingdings box.

notes: Reprint with: Chrome --headless --no-pdf-header-footer --print-to-pdf=word-symbol-fonts.pdf word-symbol-fonts.html, then update the sha256.
Chrome gives the first Symbol glyph on the page no text at all, so the page opens with a Symbol space that stands for nothing.
2026-11-23 (#86): the private-use codes were kept as the text. A glyph drawn in Symbol or Wingdings now reads as the character the font shows, by the table the DOCX reader uses.

checks.issue: Symbol's ±, ≥ and β read as U+F0B1, U+F0B3 and U+F062.
checks.text: The yield was 13.28 ± 0.61 g, at a dose ≥ 5 mg of β-cyclodextrin.

checks.issue: An equation's = and ∑ read as U+F03D and U+F0E5, and the Wingdings arrow as U+F0E0.
checks.text: The hazard index is HIi =∑HQij, and the transition 74 amu → 44 amu.

checks.issue: A Wingdings box set as a bullet stayed in the text as U+F071, which in Symbol is θ, so the line was no list item.
A guard: Symbol's bullet, read as •, still opens a list item.
